answer_2.quote: We measured exact match (EM) and F1 score by comparing the predicted and gold short answers for OTT-QA and 2WikiMultiHop. For Bird, execution accuracy was defined as 1 if the predicted and gold SQL statements produced the same execution results and 0 otherwise. For retrieval performance, we adopted the standard metrics of precision, recall, and F1 of the retrieved objects compared to the gold objects.
